snippet.title: Grime & Gold - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Grime & Gold is a small game where you play as a street alchemist, crafting potions by stacking and mixing cards. Your goal is to discover new recipes, manage scarce resources, and race against time to serve demanding clients. The game blends strategy and time management in a gritty, tense atmosphere, where every decision could lead to success or disaster. Grime & Gold coming out on Steam 20th January ! 

Steam link : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3165090/GrimeGold/

Trailer Music : 'Hour Of The Witch' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
